scientific_integrity: Complete analytic proof and reproducible finite numerical checks; same-model correctness, originality, and value assessment only. The underlying random map, finite angle classes, and Liouville invariance are credited to original literature. Publication priority subject to outside confirmation.
scientific_limitations: Only the unit Euclidean circle, reciprocal-integer roughness alpha=pi/n with n>=7, normalized Liouville initial law, and almost-sure infinite paths. Unsigned Euclidean radii, not the signed angle convention; no first-hit law, general rational-numerator extension, or arbitrary initial-distribution law.
title: Three arithmetic caustic-radius laws in rational Feres circular billiards
